description.fr-FR: Cinquième volume de l’Année liturgique : historique, mystique et pratique du Carême, le Propre du temps du premier dimanche au samedi de la quatrième semaine, et le Propre des saints.
description.en-US: Volume 5 of the 15-volume Liturgical Year (L’Année liturgique) in the original French: Lent. One chapter per day or feast, with the liturgical texts in Latin and French as the edition prints them.
description.pt-BR: Volume 5 dos 15 volumes de «O Ano Litúrgico» (L’Année liturgique) em francês: a Quaresma. Um capítulo por dia ou festa, com os textos litúrgicos em latim e francês como a edição os imprime.

fr-FR.editor: Dom Prosper Guéranger, abbé de Solesmes (14th ed., Oudin)

sources.description: Dom Guéranger site (Societas pro canonizatione D. Guéranger), WordPress text of the 14th edition (1900). Split at each day or feast heading; verse kept as hard line breaks; footnotes renumbered per chapter.
sources.tierEvidence: Guéranger died in 1875; the text is the 19th-century edition transcribed.
